questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: Very high level

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Proseminar NdL: Literatur der Alpen im 20. und 21. Jahrhundert
Proseminar NdL: Literarische Neuerscheinungen (mit Exkursion zu den Rauriser Literaturtagen)
VO Einführung in genderspezifische Kommunikations- und Organisationsstruktur

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: If you're there in the spring and interested in literature - choose Günter Stocker's course Literarische Neuerscheinungen (mit Exkursion zu den Rauriser Literaturtagen).

questions.answer: Quite easy

questions.answer: No, I found that part quite difficult. The student life doesn't seem that social in Vienna

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The café culture, the cinema culture

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. buy a nonstop subscription
2. buy a Bundesmuseen card
3. go hiking in the wine fields

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: More social events or maybe even some kind of introduction week would have been nice

questions.answer: Being surrounded by the language and culture I'm studying

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Not mastering the language but trying to
